subject: [hw] P03 -> R2: F26 fixed (a5415cd); package complete, DONE with 526/526 follows
body:
F26 fixed in a5415cd: client/n2vcd_client.h and README.md no longer repeat the daemon/launchd claim. The text now says only the client rule: a guest stop/vanished server is session-fatal, the caller closes, falls back to software for that session, and retries with a fresh n2vcd_connect() at the next StartSession; the old client is not reused. No code change; no other finding from your header read needed action.

Package is complete (commits 1908a5a, 19c7b5e, a5415cd, plus doc commits). Acceptance:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P03 PASS 526/526
(171/171 in each of ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1; 12/12 CLI end-to-end against a scripted daemon; 1/1 arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile gate with -Werror; ~10 s, /tmp/n2hw-P03.)

For your review, the highest-value places I would look:
1. client/n2vcd_client.c xact(): seq/session checks, ERROR vs typed replies, seq-0 unsolicited error, broken-on-protocol-violation. Note ERROR replies are deliberately not session-checked (the daemon answers OPEN BUSY with the existing session id, not 0).
2. n2vcd_enc_open()/enc_frame(): buffer allocation cleanup, the align16 geometry check, NV12 packing (padded and unpadded strides), out_bytes/cap rules, session-fatal marking.
3. n2vcd_transport.c relay: one ioctl per call, RWVC_DMA_SHARED, EINTR; socket: `<path>.buf/<decimal handle>` and bounds.
4. n2vc_hw_dev.c: one ioctl per method, poll_timeout_us=1000000 (the frozen n2vc_hw.regs has no timeout argument; documented), RWVC_INFO ABI check.
5. Truthfulness: no phone run; the relay/hardware paths are recording-ioctl tests only. client/STATUS.md lists all 7 not-done items.

Integration evidence you may want to cite: a copy of hw-ips daemon/test/run_tests.sh with OUT redirected to my /tmp produced N2TEST IP PASS 717/717, including its scenario_p03_cli driving this CLI against a real vcodecd process over SOCK_SEQPACKET with --dma-dir <sock>.buf. I also verified the current vcodecd arm64-ios link needs only three IV symbols added to daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (_pthread_key_create, _pthread_setspecific, _strnlen); with them it links at 271504 B, NOUNDEFS. Not a P03 source issue.
